_comment: The one identity lock for Blubie, the Blunix cat. v7 has two looks. storybook is the main look (site scene art); 3d is the secondary look (404, empty states, trait spots, Access hero, social card). Every prompt = the look's template with {cat} (the identity lock) and {scene}. Edit here, bump version, delete raw-v2 files to re-roll, and add a dated line to _log. The v6 flat-vector prompts are kept under legacy_v6 for generate.py and the archive in final/.
cat: a Russian Blue cat with a SOLID even silver-blue-grey plush coat, NO white patches, NO stripes, vivid lime-green almond eyes, dark slate nose, elegant slender build, calm composed faintly amused expression
cat_notes: Short, plush coat: a Russian Blue is not long-haired. One even silver-blue-grey, no white bib or patches, no stripes, not a tabby. Lime-green eyes. A real cat on four legs: no clothes, no collar, no human hands. Tail of normal length, smooth, not a long wavy plume.

storybook.template: Polished modern storybook illustration, soft shading, clean shapes, warm and premium. The scene: a cat {scene}. The cat is {cat}, short neat tail, bright lime-green eyes. Deep charcoal background #12161a filling the whole frame, soft rim light, generous negative space, no text, no letters, no logos, no signature

style_id_history.note: v7a: dark full-bleed, no signatures, but weak on props (hero-4/5 dropped the servers)

3d.template: Premium stylized 3D character render, soft studio lighting, Pixar-quality but understated and elegant, matte materials: {cat}, {scene}. Plain deep charcoal studio background #12161a, soft rim light, generous negative space, no text, no letters, no logos
3d.kontext_template: Keep this exact same cat: the same Russian Blue character, same face, same short plush silver-blue-grey fur, same vivid lime-green eyes, same premium stylized 3D render style, soft studio lighting and matte materials. Change only the pose and the scene: {scene}. The tail is short-furred and slim, not a pom-pom. Plain deep charcoal studio background #12161a, no server rack unless asked, no text, no letters, no logos

_log: 2026-09-30 v7: Ryan rejected the flat-vector v6 set as cheap-looking. Two approved looks from the style test: storybook (Recraft digital_illustration, B-storybook-0) as the main look, 3D (flux-pro ultra, C-3d-1) as the secondary look. Fixes carried into the prompts: the reference tail was too long and wavy ('short neat tail'); the reference had a corner mark at the bottom right (any render with a corner mark, signature or watermark is rejected); the reference's light surround is replaced by a full-bleed charcoal ground. 3D keeps identity by conditioning kontext on ref/3d-approved.png; the ref's pom-pom tail and fluffy coat are asked to stay short and plush.

2026-09-30 v7 storybook round 1 (39 candidates, style_id 7870bb23): style held across every scene (dark full-bleed, oval glow, no signatures). Rejected: speech 1-2 (no sound waves), lands-on-feet 1 (walking) and 2 (malformed stretched legs), proxy 1-2 (no cable), debugging-1 (magnifier reads as a mirror) and -2 (yellow eyes), coffee-no-1 (yellow eyes) and -2 (no can), braille-1 (yellow eyes) and -2 (no display), stargazing 1-2 (not from behind, no rack), at-computer-1 (white eyes), log-2 (white eyes), key-3 (long S-curve tail), shell-2 (pseudo-text streak on screen). Several drew pale yellow eyes: template now repeats 'bright lime-green eyes'. Re-rolled those scenes with more concrete prop wording.

2026-09-30 v7 3D round 1 (23 candidates via kontext on ref/3d-approved.png): identity held on every render (same face, ears, lime-yellow eyes, coat). Rejected: spot-peek 1-2 (sat on a ledge, not peeking), spot-stretch 1-2 (walking, not stretching), 404-1 (fine, but 404-2 has the cleaner box), empty-basket-1 (a paw inside the basket), access-2 (rings in front of the face). Storybook round 2: rejected proxy-3 (cat stands like a person with a strap across its body) and proxy-4 (upright, holds the parcel in a paw), lands-on-feet-3 (a stretch), debugging-3 (no magnifier), coffee-no-4 (a coffee cup, off-brief), braille-3/4 (no display), stargazing-3 (not from behind), at-computer-3 (pale eyes). Re-rolled spot-peek, spot-stretch, proxy and braille with more literal wording.

legacy_v6.identity: The cat is a slender adult Russian Blue, a real cat on four legs, never posed like a person. Soft, short, plush fur in one solid, even silver-blue-grey: no white patches, no stripes, not a tabby, not black, not a hairless Sphynx. Almond eyes filled with vivid lime-green irises and thin dark pupils, never white or grey eyes. Large, wide-set pointed ears, dark slate-grey nose. Calm, faintly amused, elegant, not cartoon-cute. No collar, no clothing.
legacy_v6.style_lock: Flat editorial geometric vector illustration: flat colour shapes, fine minimal linework, slate blue-greys on deep charcoal, lime green only for the eyes and tiny indicator lights, generous negative space, calm and quiet. Plain dark charcoal background. No text, no letters, no numbers, no logos, no writing anywhere.

_log: 2026-09-30 v1 probes: base style drew black outlines and a beige coat (muted cream in colors pulled the coat warm); editorial substyle put a yellow backdrop in; roundish_flat gave a striped tabby with a white bib and a white background. Dropped cream from colors, banned outlines, pushed the flat charcoal ground.

2026-09-30 v2 probes: cutout and segmented_colors held the cat best (slender, solid slate coat, lime eyes, no tabby). Backgrounds are ignored by every substyle (red, blue, purple, pale green), so finish.py drops the full-canvas background path and snaps all colours to the Blunix ramp. Locked vector_illustration/segmented_colors. v1/v2 prompts were silently over the 1000-char limit; shortened identity and style_lock, and generate.py now refuses long prompts.

2026-09-30 v3 review (56 candidates): about half drew white or grey eyes (reject), several drifted toward a hairless Sphynx with bat ears and skin creases, two dressed the cat as a person (proxy-1 standing figures, 404-2 in a suit, at-computer-1 in a shirt), and some added a collar (log-1, held-still-1) or white patches (hero-3 bib, packing-1 blaze, sticker-paw-1 tail). Empty-basket put the cat inside the basket both times. v4 identity: eye colour stated as irises + 'never white or grey', plush fur + 'not a hairless Sphynx', 'real cat on four legs, never posed like a person'. finish.py now also removes large backdrop panels touching three canvas edges, and caps Ink to glints.

2026-09-30 v4 review (27 rerolls): eyes held green on most full-body poses; close front-facing faces (reading-docs, braille, coffee-no, sticker-peek) still drew white or grey eyes, braille-4 added a collar, empty-basket-3 added colour swatches. sticker-loaf never produced a loaf (tunnels, frames) and is dropped from the set. Final round: those four scenes repeat the eye colour inside the scene text.

2026-09-30 v5 review: coffee-no-5 passed. braille-5 dressed the cat in a suit with human hands; braille-6, reading-docs-5 and both sticker-peek rolls still drew grey eyes on a front-facing close face; reading-docs-6 gave the cat human hands. sticker-peek dropped (Watchful uses the key scene). Last roll for braille and reading-docs: three-quarter side view, full body, so the face is small and the eyes read as lime.

2026-09-30 finish.py bug found and fixed: once the Ink cap was tightened to 0.2% of the canvas, it overrode the green pool, so any eye larger than that snapped to light grey. Close-up faces looked grey-eyed in review and were rejected for it (braille, reading-docs, sticker-peek, coffee-no and 404 rerolls were partly spent on this). The raw files had lime eyes all along. Green is now gated on shape instead: eye-like bounding boxes (0.9 to 2.0 wide per tall, under 2% of the canvas) or tiny dots keep green; inner ears (about 0.55) and ruled lines go to slate. All 99 candidates were re-reviewed after the fix.
